title: 1M CC is great around 300-700k
author: AgenticGameDev
selftext: I think the CC is great around 300 -700k as it has great background knowledge but still don't have end stress. After 700k It starts to lose reason and don't understand the complexity of game dev.. What is your experience?

comments.author: count023
comments.body: you shouldn't be letting your context get that long anyway. Claude works best when it gest right ot the point, does a job, you finish teh task and move in fresh context, just eating up 1 million tokens is a way of eating up your usage if you're just keeping your entire project thread in history. and you will find context poioning is pretty consistnt on all LLMs around the 500k token mark. it's beee pretty well established these days.

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body:
Interesting, I feel like Claude code is less problematic and the benefit of loading in context up front on similar task make it so that the AI knows a lot of things it needs to consider in a huge code base. (I’m not loading in the code base :) ). So I keep my agents around a bit longer. 

What do you feel degraded around 500k?

replies.author: count023
replies.body: honestly, it's reasoning and troubleshooting. I've found that early on it can plan and execute well as wel as catch exceptions proactively and create good debug and testing criteria, as ot goes past 500k it starts making silly mistakes like creating static dependcies, duplicating data, announcing tests are succesful wtihout even finishing coding, stuff like that. So it kinda starts sniffing it's own farts, if you will.

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Great I will try to stop it att 500k then:) Thank you for sharing.

replies.author: Harvard_Med_USMLE267
replies.body:
Have you actually tested this on Claude Code?

When?

Widespread 1 million token availability has only been out for a week, it seems a bit premature to be writing it off unless you’ve somehow tested it extensively with Opus 4.6 in that time.

replies.author: count023
replies.body: 1 million tokens was available to people in beta on certain max plans over hte last few months, so yes, i have tested it. Not with Opus 4.6 so much but both older sonnet and opus.

replies.author: Harvard_Med_USMLE267
replies.body:
Ok but not 4.6 and beta only.

I’m keeping an open mind on this one.

I tend to quit around 250-300k but that’s because of town limits, I don’t notice any degradation. But I have no experience at 500K plus.
